result.summary: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover edge cases and boundary conditions in `src/script/script.cpp`. The additions target surviving mutants identified by mutation testing, exercising `CScript::IsPayToTaproot`, `GetSigOpCount`, `IsPayToAnchor`, `HasValidOps`, `CScript::GetOp`, and `CScriptWitness::ToString`.
result.problem: Multiple boundary checks and validation logic paths in core script parsing and classification functions lacked explicit unit test coverage, leaving live mutants undetected by the test suite.
evidence: Author description identifies 11 specific live mutant IDs from https://bitcoincore.space/public/mutation_data.json killed by these targeted test assertions.
Diff directly tests previously uncovered boundary conditions, including non-P2SH sigop counting accuracy, OP_1 and OP_16 multisig limits, MAX_OPCODE boundaries, and truncated pushdata opcodes.
result.scope_notes: Clean addition of unit tests organized into four self-contained commits, touching only test files.
result.changed_since_previous: Diff inspected; the patch adds 161 lines of unit tests across four files with no production code changes.
result.card: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to eliminate eleven live mutants identified by automated mutation testing in src/script/script.cpp. Covers edge cases in Pay-to-Taproot validation, Pay-to-Anchor parsing, SigOp counting boundaries, opcode bounds in HasValidOps, and truncated pushdata handling in CScript::GetOp. No production code logic is modified.

risk.why: Only touches unit test files, adding new assertions without changing test harness behavior or production code.
